method: Visual inspection of all 16 original frames against same-index pose guides; no automated arm measurement or numerical joint accuracy claim.
source_art: Even frames: out/2-keys; odd frames: out/3-inbetweens
sequence_required: W00 back -> W04 neutral -> W08 front -> W12 neutral -> W00 back, with far arm opposite; relaxed open hands and small swing.
source_generation_problem: The accepted W07 prompt explicitly told the generator to keep BOTH ARMS AND HANDS essentially unchanged. Other passing notes verified limbs/feet but did not independently verify shoulder-elbow-wrist continuity.
foot_measurement_result: Unchanged. Eight odd frames pass feet_check.py; that tool does not inspect arms.

correction_scope: Re-establish a coherent small arm swing in key poses first, then redraw in-betweens halfway in shoulder/elbow/wrist position; preserve face, head, costume, leg identity and measured foot placements. Use side-by-side/onion-skin and slow playback plus all existing feet checks. Do not try to solve wrong key-arm anchors by changing odd frames alone.
